metadata.currency: Text contains those laws in effect on April 8, 2026
metadata.source_credit: (Added Pub. L. 98–369, div. A, title II, §211(a), July 18, 1984, 98 Stat. 721 .)

children.label: (a)
children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this part, the term "life insurance gross income" means the sum of the following amounts:

children.heading: Premiums
children.text: (A) The gross amount of premiums and other consideration on insurance and annuity contracts, less (B) return premiums, and premiums and other consideration arising out of indemnity reinsurance.

children.heading: Decreases in certain reserves
children.text: Each net decrease in reserves which is required by section 807(a) to be taken into account under this paragraph.

children.heading: Other amounts
children.text: All amounts not includible under paragraph (1) or (2) which under this subtitle are includible in gross income.

children.heading: Certain items included
children.text: For purposes of subsection (a)(1)(A), the term "gross amount of premiums and other consideration" includes- (A) advance premiums, (B) deposits, (C) fees, (D) assessments, (E) consideration in respect of assuming liabilities under contracts not issued by the taxpayer, and (F) the amount of policyholder dividends reimbursable to the taxpayer by a reinsurer in respect of reinsured policies, on insurance and annuity contracts.

children.heading: Policyholder dividends excluded from return premiums

children.label: (A)
children.heading: In general
children.text: Except as provided in subparagraph (B), the term "return premiums" does not include any policyholder dividends.

children.label: (B)
children.heading: Exception for indemnity reinsurance
children.text: Subparagraph (A) shall not apply to amounts of premiums or other consideration returned to another life insurance company in respect of indemnity reinsurance.

other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 803, acts Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 256 ; Mar. 13, 1956, ch. 83, §2, 70 Stat. 39 , related to income and deductions in the case of life insurance companies, prior to the general revision of this part by Pub. L. 86–69, §2(a), June 25, 1959, 73 Stat. 112 .

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section applicable to taxable years beginning after Dec. 31, 1983, see section 215 of Pub. L. 98–369, set out as a note under section 801 of this title.
